decisions.issue: architecture question versus premature narrow continuity choice
decisions.decision: Select integrated graph/evidence-mediated research-system comparison as the next research programme, not graph as the winning architecture. Negative-result reuse and recovery are mechanism diagnostics. Rank compression and meta-evolution as conditional later alternatives.

Use B/C/G as the working development architecture screen: strong source-backed iterative tree; same tree with compulsory schema-neutral review and capsule; same obligations expressed via graph/evidence control. G-C isolates the graph-control package increment; C-B describes compulsory-process contribution. It does not identify pure graph topology. A passive-graph fourth arm is conditional on demonstrated identifiability need and authorized cost, not mandatory. Freeze the selected candidate and strongest credible competitor after development, before held-out campaigns. If the selected contrast is G-B, label it a package comparison rather than graph-only effect.
decisions.reason: Three arms address the strongest additional-deliberation explanation without making a four-cell programme an uncalculated prerequisite. Preserve original 2x2 and staged-two-arm proposals as alternatives.

decisions.issue: proposed 6/24 family minima versus two-family completion statement
decisions.decision: Do not adopt any fixed minimum or power claim from review. Derive sample size from task-family heterogeneity, nested randomness, minimum useful effect or target precision, attrition and full-cost scenarios in development. Two families can show feasibility only, not precise population null. Six and twenty-four are planning suggestions, not evidence-backed universal thresholds.

Require observed sequences in which previous results change a later research decision, not only elapsed time. Use 4 decisions/2 dependent decisions/1 restart/relevant and irrelevant revisions as a proposed development stress template, not a validated universal definition. Freeze task-specific criteria before confirmation; assess natural ML-task fit rather than forcing synthetic edits into every primary campaign.

decisions.issue: independent assessor denied hidden bytes it must use
decisions.decision: Separate trusted deterministic scoring process from untrusted LLM critic. Trusted scorer may read sealed hidden data/test inside its boundary; planner/developer/critic must not. Final scorer gets selected artifact plus evaluation manifest, not treatment-labelled research trace. Human/rubric calibration is separate from primary deterministic score. No claim that same-model role separation provides error independence.

Use an internal stable intent ID and at-most-once import/binding. Proposed remote reconciliation depends on a verified provider capability; installed ORX help does not establish request-ID lookup or atomic idempotent submission. Missing/ambiguous status is UNKNOWN, not NOT_RUN. No automatic relaunch until a capability-specific protocol and authority resolve it. At-most-once local binding is not exactly-once external execution.

DiscoveryPort owns candidate search; SourceEvidenceService owns byte/version/read/locator evidence; PaperService is a read-only consumer of a closed evidence snapshot after research completion. ORX retains scientific-run lifecycle; Prime/Pi retains process/session lifecycle. This is a design contract, not new native implementation.

decisions.issue: writing and final figure-release circular gate
decisions.decision: ResearchDone closes frozen experiment/analysis/selection/claim evidence and permits manuscript construction. PublicationReady then checks finished prose, figures/alt/title/desc, bibliography, numbers, rendered pages and human release. Final figure pixels and metadata cannot be prerequisites to writing the manuscript that creates them. No new manuscript prose in this integration. Valid null/negative completes a properly scoped programme; invalid-only cannot claim efficacy and needs an explicit scope decision.

Rebind 21 existing exact locators across 13 prior sources plus the eight-paper recent bundle. This restores known antecedents, not a new full literature closure. Keep exact residual UNESTABLISHED and SOTA NOT_CLAIMABLE until direct comparator/task and held-out evidence exist.

User permits necessary research-tool installations, but do not install a graph database/orchestrator to signal modernity. Compare required capability, existing owner, measured bottleneck or reproducibility need, version/license/security and rollback. Project-local dependencies only; new paid compute/accounts/native restart require separate authority.
